headline: Household Loans at Five Major Banks Rise by Over 4 Trillion Won for Second Month… ‘Reverse Money Move’ as KOSPI Wobbles
summary: Household loans at South Korea's five major commercial banks rose between 3 and 4 trillion won for two consecutive months. Real estate purchase demand and borrowing to invest are combining despite government regulation.
why: Household lending by large commercial banks is a key indicator of credit conditions and housing-market risk in South Korea.
